source.title: The global distribution and environmental drivers of aboveground versus belowground plant biomass

scope: Forests, shrublands and grasslands; cropland excluded from global RMF mapping. Habitat categories are not taxonomic tree/shrub/grass species fractions.
warnings: Root masses and root fractions are not probabilities among plant categories
Do not treat an ecosystem carbon stock as a single species biomass
Need integrated aboveground plus belowground totals and a non-overlapping partition including omitted habitats before adopting weights
Do not infer a global category total by dividing a root total by an unverified spatially averaged RMF
